questions.question: Prometheus qanday ishlaydi: pull model, exporter, scrape?
questions.explanation: Prometheus har `scrape_interval`da target'larning `/metrics` endpoint'idan HTTP orqali metrikalarni tortadi (pull) va o'z TSDB'sida saqlaydi. Exporter — o'z metrikasini bermaydigan tizim uchun tarjimon (node_exporter, postgres_exporter).

questions.question: Prometheus metrika turlari: counter, gauge, histogram, summary?
questions.explanation: counter — faqat o'sadi (request soni), `rate()` bilan ishlatiladi; gauge — yuqoriga/pastga (xotira, navbat uzunligi); histogram — bucket'lar bo'yicha taqsimot (latency), server tomonda quantile; summary — client tomonda quantile, agregatsiya qilib bo'lmaydi.

questions.question: Asosiy PromQL so'rovlar: rate, sum by, histogram_quantile?
questions.explanation: `rate(counter[5m])` — sekundiga o'rtacha o'sish; `sum by (label)` — agregatsiya; `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(..._bucket[5m])))` — p99.

questions.question: `rate()` va `irate()` farqi, nega counter'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qaralmaydi?
questions.explanation: Counter faqat o'sadi va restart'da 0 ga tushadi — xom qiymat ma'nosiz. rate() oraliqdagi o'rtacha sekundlik o'sish (reset'ni hisobga oladi); irate() oxirgi ikki nuqta — sakrashli, alert'ga yaramaydi.

questions.question: Exporter nima? Eng ko'p ishlatiladiganlari?
questions.explanation: Exporter — tizim metrikasini Prometheus formatida /metrics da beradigan process. node_exporter (server), cAdvisor/kube-state-metrics (K8s), postgres/redis exporter, blackbox_exporter (tashqi probe).

questions.question: Label'lar va kardinallik: nega `user_id`ni label qilish xavfli?
questions.explanation: Har unikal label kombinatsiyasi = alohida time series. `user_id`, `request_id`, to'liq URL kabi chegarasiz qiymatlar millionlab series yaratadi — xotira, sekin so'rov, Prometheus OOM.

questions.question: Alerting qoidasi va Alertmanager qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Prometheus alert rule'ni baholaydi; shart `for` davomida rost bo'lsa alert firing bo'ladi va Alertmanager'ga yuboriladi. Alertmanager group/dedupe, route (jamoa bo'yicha), inhibit, silence va notify qiladi.

questions.question: Grafana'da yaxshi dashboard qanday quriladi?
questions.explanation: Yuqorida servis sog'ligi (RED: rate, errors, duration p50/p95/p99), keyin resurslar (USE), variable'lar (env, service), bir xil vaqt oralig'i, birliklar va threshold'lar. Dashboard kod sifatida (JSON/Terraform/provisioning).

questions.question: node_exporter bilan server monitoringi: qaysi metrikalarga qaraladi?
questions.explanation: CPU (usage, iowait, steal), load, memory (MemAvailable), disk (bo'sh joy, inode, IO util/latency), network (trafik, xatolar), filesystem read-only, systemd servislar.

questions.question: Kubernetes'da Prometheus target'larni qanday topadi? ServiceMonitor nima?
questions.explanation: kubernetes_sd_configs — K8s API'dan pod/service/endpoint'larni topadi, relabel bilan filtrlaydi. Prometheus Operator'da ServiceMonitor/PodMonitor CRD — label selector bilan deklarativ scrape.

questions.question: Prometheus'ni scale qilish va uzoq muddat saqlash: federation, remote_write, Thanos/Mimir?
questions.explanation: Bitta Prometheus vertikal scale bo'ladi va lokal disk (odatda 15-30 kun). Ko'p cluster va uzoq retention uchun: remote_write yoki Thanos sidecar orqali object storage'ga, global query (Thanos/Mimir/VictoriaMetrics), HA juftlik + dedupe.
